Gagola 2009, Conjugacy of Sylow 2-Subloops of the Chein Loops M_2n(G,2), doi:10.1080/00927870802623450: snippet states odd-p Sylow subloops of Chein loops are conjugate (treated as seen) and proves the 2-case; covers conjugacy direction only, not exact n3=1 with Inn-216 certificate.
Grishkov-Zavarnitsine, Sylow's theorem for Moufang loops, arXiv:0709.2696 / J.Algebra 321(7) 2009: general existence criterion and maximal p-subloop orders; no per-loop n3=1 for M(S3,2).

Chein 1974 Trans.AMS / 1978 Memoirs: classification of nonassociative Moufang loops of order <=31 (13 loops), solvable, satisfying Lagrange and Sylow theorems; no recorded n3=1 plus Inn-conjugacy certificate for L12.

LOOPS package manual (Nagy-Vojtechovsky, cs.du.edu/~petr/loops/doc/manual.pdf): GAP library of small/Moufang/Paige loops with subloop and inner-mapping-group methods; a computable framework, not a recorded statement that n3(M(S3,2))=1 with the Inn certificate.
